st: Stranded in the Alaska Wild Part 2
d: Adrian Knopps shares the details of his ordeal in the remote parts of Alaska's Misty Fjord, after finding himself trapped by a tidal surge.
Pastor Mike Turner becomes trapped under a boulder for 11 excruciating days.

t: Extreme Road Rescue: Rush Hour Blizzard
d: During the coldest snap of the century, huge drifts of snow trap a council plow in the Highlands  the RAC patrols battle to stay on the road to reach snowed-in motorists and heavy-recovery specialists in Northampton are pushed to the limit.

t: Emergency Rescue: Air, Land and Sea: Vigilant Sky and Sea Warriors
d: Brave rescuers battle extreme conditions across the UK to save lives on land, sea and air.

In Yorkshire, Neil needs urgent attention after a fall from his motorbike  the medics head to the banks of Ullswater when a walker goes into a cardiac arrest  in Berkshire, Darran suffers nasty burns in an accident lighting a bonfire.

t: Stop Search Seize: Eyes on the Gateways
d: Customs officer John Heffernan organizes an operation to intercept illegally imported cigarettes entering Ireland by road.
Border Force agents are on the money at Heathrow Airport.
A charismatic passenger stirs up conflict between the immigration staff, while customs officers target those smuggling animal products.
